## What's in 1.21.3

- **Fix: background tasks that finished quickly no longer stall.** A background `gh run watch` whose CI run finished fast could sit "running" forever with no output, and the agent was never woken. Every background-task registry mutation now re-checks RUNNING rows against Rust's authoritative registry and reconciles lost completions automatically.
- Plus everything in 1.21.2: wake/resume turns render as clearly-badged "Background work" continuations of the same conversation (no more phantom second conversation), and a second spawn of an identical already-running command is refused instead of racing on the same files.
